tier_label: Viscosity modifier - adds to the general block

polymer_chemistry.notes: Type from the printed title 'Non-Dispersant Olefin Copolymer Viscosity Modifier'; form from 'Appearance: Clear to slightly hazy greenish tan viscous liquid' (PDS 05/23, p.2). The 03/18 edition says it is 'based on a solid polymer'; the solid polymer content is not printed.

value.calculation_note: 'Typical Characteristics' (PDS 05/23, p.2). No test method or cycle count is printed, so the value is not usable for calculation (usable: false). Afton's 03/18 and 04/21 editions also print SSI 22; the 07/11 edition says 'It is based on 23 SSI polymer' (base polymer, a different basis). The HiTEC 12360 bulletin DL2-13692.pdf (07/20) describes 'HiTEC® 5748 25SSI OCP'; no method is printed there either, so the values are not shown to be comparable and no conflict is recorded (see open questions).

temperature_c.calculation_note: Not printed. The PDS 'Max Handling Temp: 250°F (120°C)' is a handling limit, not a dissolution or blend temperature.

open_questions: SSI discrepancy, not reconciled: Afton's HiTEC 5748 PDS prints 'Shear Stability Index %: 22' (05/23 and 04/21) and 'a typical Shear Stability Index (SSI) of 22' (03/18); the 07/11 edition says 'It is based on 23 SSI polymer' (base-polymer basis); Afton's HiTEC 12360 bulletin DL2-13692.pdf (07/20, p.2) describes 'HiTEC® 5748 25SSI OCP' / '25SSI viscosity modifier'. None of these documents prints the SSI test method, cycle count or base oil, so comparability is not established and no conflict entry is recorded. Confirm the SSI and its method with Afton.

Treat range: the PDS gives one dosage per SAE grade in vol.% only (10 hour L-38 stay-in-grade, with CMCC DIN 51382 values in parentheses: 5W-30 8.0 (8.0), 10W-30 5.7 (5.8), 10W-40 11.6 (11.8), 15W-40 5.4 (5.5), 20W-50 5.4 (5.5) vol.%). No wt.% dosage and no min/max range are published, so treat_range_wt_pct stays Missing; the vol.% recommendations are kept in external_fill_notes and must not be used as wt.% inputs. Ask Afton for wt.% dosages.

Thickening response, post-shear KV100, HTHS, CCS/MRV impact, low-temperature gelation, active polymer content, carrier and dissolution/blend temperature are not printed; left Missing. The printed 'Dilute Viscosity @ 100°C, cSt: 11.55' has no stated reference oil or dose, so it is not entered as a thickening response.
